newsOverlay.marketBias: The Federal Reserve has raised the target range by 25 bp to 3.75%-4.00%, while the 20:30 Europe/Madrid press conference remains an immediate HIGH volatility catalyst. Crypto Reca technical state independently shows no trade across BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, AVAX and HBAR. Intelligence alone creates neither a buy nor a sell signal.

items.headline: Federal Reserve raises target rate 25 bp to 3.75%-4.00%
items.summary: Contemporaneous reporting confirms the FOMC raised its policy rate by 25 basis points to 3.75%-4.00%, the first increase since 2023. The immediate focus shifts to Chair Kevin Warsh's 20:30 Madrid press conference and the tightening path signaled by the projections.
items.whyItMatters: A renewed Fed tightening cycle can lift real yields and the dollar and reduce risk-asset liquidity; the path signaled after the decision can matter more than the well-priced 25 bp move itself.
items.actionReason: The rate decision is resolved but the HIGH press conference catalyst is less than two hours away; avoid new entry until the immediate event-risk window clears unless Crypto Reca explicitly tolerates it.

items.headline: Dollar and yields remain restrictive into Fed decision
items.summary: Reuters reported the dollar near a two-week high before the decision, with markets heavily pricing a quarter-point hike and further tightening. Global markets remained sensitive to the near-5% U.S. 10-year yield and oil above $100.
items.whyItMatters: High yields and a firm dollar tighten financial conditions for crypto and other risk assets.
items.actionReason: Restrictive macro conditions remain material but do not independently justify REDUCE REVIEW or EXIT REVIEW.

items.headline: U.S. Senate fails to advance CLARITY Act
items.summary: The Senate procedural vote failed 49-50, short of the 60 votes required to advance the digital-asset market-structure bill. The failure extended U.S. regulatory uncertainty and was followed by material weakness across crypto, especially XRP.
items.whyItMatters: Failure to advance the bill removes a near-term path to broader U.S. market-structure clarity and can sustain a regulatory risk premium.
items.actionReason: The event is resolved and negative but is not a direct protocol failure and does not independently trigger a sale.

items.headline: U.S. 10-year Treasury yield crosses 5%, highest since 2023
items.summary: Reuters reported the U.S. 10-year Treasury yield above 5% amid renewed inflation concerns, oil-price pressure and expectations of restrictive Fed policy.
items.whyItMatters: A 5% 10-year yield raises the opportunity cost of holding risk assets and can pressure crypto liquidity and valuations.
items.actionReason: Material tightening in financial conditions, not an independent sell instruction.

items.headline: Oman postpones planned Iran-Gulf Hormuz meeting; no new date announced
items.summary: Reuters reported the planned meeting between Gulf states and Iran was postponed with no replacement date announced.
items.whyItMatters: The postponement extends uncertainty around oil supply, inflation, yields and crypto risk liquidity.
items.actionReason: Material macro risk but not a direct crypto protocol failure.

items.headline: Saudi pipeline outage could threaten roughly 4% of global oil supply if repairs drag on
items.summary: Reuters reported the damaged Saudi East-West pipeline had been rerouting about 4 million barrels per day and could materially reduce exports if not restored within days.
items.whyItMatters: A prolonged outage would deepen the energy shock and sustain inflation and yield pressure on global risk liquidity.
items.actionReason: Material macro risk but not an independent sell trigger.

catalysts.headline: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh post-FOMC press conference
catalysts.summary: The Federal Reserve is holding its post-meeting press conference at 2:30 p.m. ET, 20:30 Madrid. Markets will focus on whether the September hike begins a broader tightening cycle.
catalysts.whyItMatters: Forward guidance can materially reset yields, the dollar and crypto liquidity immediately after the rate decision.
catalysts.actionReason: HIGH scheduled catalyst is less than two hours away.

catalysts.headline: Bank of Japan policy decision expected to raise rate to 1.25%
catalysts.summary: Reuters reports the Bank of Japan is expected to raise rates to 1.25%, a 31-year high, as inflation risks persist.
catalysts.whyItMatters: Further Japanese tightening can affect global yields, yen carry trades and risk-asset liquidity.
catalysts.actionReason: Reliable HIGH catalyst inside seven days but not yet inside the 24-hour volatility window.
